Select Board, May 2024

A Brief History
2019: Begin work (with MAPC) to develop Bicycle & Pedestrian Master Plan for Lincoln
2020: Stakeholders kickoff meeting with representatives from Roadway & Traffic
Committee, Department of Public Works and Planning Department
2021: Plan development, including work with Planning Department, Conservation
Department and Roadway & Traffic Committee. Presented Advisory Shoulder pilot
concept to the town at November SOTT
2022: First draft completed. Engaged with Conservation Commission, Parks & Recreation
Commission, Roadway & Traffic Committee, School Committee, Planning Board, Capital
Planning Committee and Select Board to review plan and solicit feedback
Four public forums, each focused on one region of Lincoln
Presented Master Plan at SOTT in Nov 2022
